missing_fields: Complete supplied four-page main, four figures, three tables, three equations and ten bibliography entries. SI and cited full sources unreviewed.
Thirteen Table I preparation rows are retained separately; these are source-reported variants, not independently reproduced runs.
H2S gas amount/flow/purity, passage duration, vessel geometry/capacity and stirring rate are unreported. No gas-volume or stoichiometric charge is inferred.
For six first rows pH is variable, with source footnote stating that it changes with introduced H2S. Numerical pH-adjusting chemicals or quantities are not supplied for fixed-pH rows.

Ultrasonic treatment is a yes/no preparation distinction; frequency, power, duration and timing are unreported. The source prints 290 K for the first ultrasonic row and 271 K for the pH 14 row; neither is silently corrected.
Spraying uses a closed chamber filled/flushed with H2S and continuous solution recycling. Spray rate, nozzle, chamber volume, recycling flow/duration and pH are unreported.
Filter hardware and vacuum-desiccator pressure/temperature are unreported; source residue storage/drying is two days. No wash step or yield is invented.

Figure 1 and Figure 2/text identify pH 12; Table I instead prints pH 14 for its 12.9 nm row. Table II gives specimen 1 XRD size 12.9 nm. Equal size is not sufficient to resolve this pH or batch-assignment discrepancy; microscopy/electrical specimens remain separate supporting contexts.

Table II/III specimens have measured TEM/XRD/electrical outcomes, but their exact Table I recipe rows are not uniquely linked by explicit source labels. Specimen 2/3 recipes are not inferred by matching diameters.

TEM specimen preparation is deferred to cited reference 8, not read. Cold-press pressure/dwell and individual powder mass are unreported; silver paint formulation is a named commercial material, not pure elemental silver.

Theoretical band gaps, model-equivalent particle diameters and calculated interparticle separations are author calculations, distinct from TEM dimensions and electrical estimates. The text lists 2.0/2.9/5.3 nm and then summarizes 3–5 nm; both source statements remain without reconciliation.
No measured atomic coordinates or complete coordinate-based training readiness. Independent source comparison passed; molecular/particle presentation remains pending.
conflicts: Figure 1 and Figure 2/text identify pH 12; Table I instead prints pH 14 for its 12.9 nm row. Table II gives specimen 1 XRD size 12.9 nm. Equal size is not sufficient to resolve this pH or batch-assignment discrepancy; microscopy/electrical specimens remain separate supporting contexts.
